Minor variations in shower timing, cloud thickness, or model consensus on the low’s track could nudge the outcome by 1–2°C, consistent with the close market-implied probabilities around these levels. Updated JMA briefings and short-range model runs on the morning of the 27th will provide the clearest resolution signals for traders.
